featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited [Padmavati Book Store ] and it was delightful! The cozy atmosphere and well-curated selection make it a gem. They also offer book rentals at unbeatable prices, making it an excellent choice for budget-conscious readers. Highly recommended for book lovers looking for a quaint spot to find great reads!

featured_reviews.name: Shabeer Mohamedappa
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a book library, including a semi-stationery store. You can rent books for reading and even sell old books here. The rental fees are reasonable, and they take a security deposit to ensure the safe return of their books. Despite its small size, you can find all popular book titles at this shop. It's a typical retail shop and do not offer any space to sit and read. They accept both cash and GPay. Overall, it's a decent book shop in the Goregaon area.

featured_reviews.name: Aakanksha Ahire
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the best book stores in the Suburbs. With so many purchasing and renting options available, Padmavati Bookstore is one of a kind. The next time you're in Goregaon, this place should be a must-visit!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this bookstore recently. It was my first every visit to a crossword bookstore. The bookstore was clean and aesthetically pleasing.

The books were properly segregated on the basis of genre and there was a satisfactorily large collection of books, especially the new trending books.

I am not fond of self-help books in general and find that bookstores tend to promote those much more than fiction, the same was the case here. But, you can find quality books on the end shelves of the bookstore.

There was also someone sitting there, reading the books then and there. I wondered if this was allowed or not, if it is please let me know I'd love to have checked out some of those books before buying.

The books are high quality but equally expensive. There are no discounts or offers, that was a little disappointing. All the accessory was also somewhat overpriced.

The shopkeeper was polite, but wasn't very helpful in finding some of the books that I wanted.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Kannaujiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Crossword at Oberoi Mall is a fantastic bookstore experience, deserving of high marks, especially for its collection and customer service.
​The staff here are truly the highlight—sincere, friendly, and clearly passionate about books, always ready to help you find exactly what you're looking for. The selection of titles, from popular novels to specialized business and investment books, is excellent.
​The only minor drawback is the lack of dedicated seating within the store, but Crossword at grant road sitting area also available,meaning it’s not a place to settle down for a long read. However, here's a local tip: since the mall has great cafes, grab your new books here and head up to the Third Wave Coffee on the 3rd floor for a comfortable and focused reading session.
​If you’re looking for great books and genuine staff interaction, this Crossword location is highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Aks KR
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience. The setting is very chill and has good vibes. We can spend great time on your own or with friends while reading good collection of books. Also, the staff are great and realy helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Shyam Jakhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐
This bookstore is truly a paradise for anyone who loves books, learning, and a peaceful environment. From the moment you step inside, you can feel a calm and positive atmosphere that immediately makes you want to slow down, explore, and spend time among books. The layout of the store is extremely well planned, with clearly organized sections that make it easy to find exactly what you’re looking for, whether it’s fiction, non-fiction, academic books, self-help, children’s books, or reference material.
One of the best things about this bookstore is the quality and variety of its collection. The shelves are well-stocked with both popular titles and hard-to-find books, which shows how thoughtfully the collection has been curated. Whether you are a casual reader, a student preparing for exams, a professional looking to upgrade your knowledge, or someone searching for a meaningful gift, this store has something for everyone.
The ambience deserves special appreciation. The lighting is comfortable for reading, the space is clean and well-maintained, and the overall environment is quiet and welcoming. It feels like a place where you can take your time, browse without pressure, and truly enjoy the experience of being surrounded by books. Unlike crowded or noisy shops, this bookstore allows you to focus and connect with what you are reading.
The staff here are another major highlight. They are polite, knowledgeable, and genuinely interested in helping customers. Instead of just pointing towards shelves, they take the time to understand what you are looking for and often suggest great alternatives or better options. Their behavior makes customers feel respected and valued, which is something not every store can achieve.
Pricing is fair and transparent, with good value for money considering the quality of books and service provided. There are often good recommendations, new arrivals, and well-maintained stock, which shows the store’s commitment to readers and education. The billing process is smooth, and overall customer handling is professional.
What truly sets this bookstore apart is the experience it offers. It is not just a place to buy books; it is a place to discover ideas, gain knowledge, and spend quality time. You leave the store feeling satisfied, inspired, and eager to return again.
I would highly recommend this bookstore to students, readers, parents, professionals, and anyone who appreciates books and a calm, respectful shopping experience. This is one of those rare bookstores that leaves a lasting impression and becomes your go-to place once you visit. A must-visit for every book lover.

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is for non education books. Fiction, non-fiction, novels. For kids, teens and adults. Books are in good condition. Owner has return policy of 70%. Which is very good. I had taken books for my kids. Returned in 3 weeks time and then took another set.

featured_reviews.name: viraj galia
featured_reviews.review_text: There are many varieties of fiction and non fiction books available here. You can take it and return it and get certain money back. The books are in good condition. The sad part is it isn't a store, the place is just under a roof.

featured_reviews.name: K L B
featured_reviews.review_text: You can find books and author based books , theme based books, Subject based Bokks, and anything but Books. The the colourful hard cover or soft cover books with the best of the quality of variety in today's 21st century age of Digital era. Recommended for those with innate ability to turn pages as well as to buy a Pages laden book

featured_reviews.name: Navin Nathani
featured_reviews.review_text:
A simple guy who can ensure your imagination about books can go wild.

He is a running Amazon who can recommend books, quickly add it to your cart and checkout is the quickest - cash or digital.

All he needs is a smile.

A must place to buy all genres of books, his collection is interesting and definitely charges much lesser than others.

A must place to visit if you are a bookie....

featured_reviews.name: Neelam Bhasin
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice person has thousands of books you name it and he ll get it for you, has excellent knowledge regarding all types of book, very humble and polite person...if you return the book within the period he gives you certain amount back ...
